name: W25Q64-flash
description: Hardware-agnostic driver for W25Q64 SPI NOR flash. Compatible with Winbond W25Q64 and clones (XMC XM25QH64C, BOYA BY25Q64). Provides read, write, erase, and power management via user-supplied SPI transfer and delay callbacks.
keywords: flash, nor-flash, spi, w25q64, winbond, storage, stm32
